About Us
About Government Model College, Deithor
With an aim to achieve expansion in higher education with inclusion, equity and quality and to enhance access to degree courses in Educationally Backward Districts (EBDs), the Government of India decided to set up Model Degree Colleges in the EBDs. Although initially these institutes are developed as institutes for Higher Secondary and Under Graduate, the government also has a plan to introduce Post Graduate (PG) level / Skill development courses in future as per National Education Policy 2020 (NEP 2020). With this plan in view, Government Model College, Deithor, Karbi Anglong has been established by the Higher Education Department, Government of Assam under the Directorate of Higher Education with an intention of spreading higher education in the remote and comparatively underdeveloped area of Karbi Anglong. In 2013, Karbi-Anglong Autonomous Council (KAAC) allotted 35 bighas of land to the Government Model College, Deithor under the Chilonijan Revenue Circle. The funding for the college has been provided jointly by the Government of Assam and Rashtriya Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan (RUSA). Dr. Dipok Kumar Bora joined as the Principal of the College on 15th September 2020. Under his leadership, the institute grows and he acts as a coordinator for activities concerning the College. The College is affiliated to Dibrugarh University, Dibrugarh vide Government notification AHE. 570/2016/53 dated 15.10.2020. Following Dr. Bora's appointment, 17 (seventeen) Assistant Professors in six departments i.e., English, Assamese, Economics, Education, Sociology and Political Science along with a Librarian have been appointed by Directorate of Higher Education (DHE), Government of Assam as per latest UGC norms/qualifications. At present, the college has a total of 20 faculty members. A total of 63 students have enrolled in the very first session of the college. The college has started regular classes from 28 December 2020.

Dr. Phulmoni Das
Principal i/c
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to Government Model College, Deithor, a young institution established in 2020 with the vision of providing quality higher education to the students of Karbi Anglong and the surrounding areas. As Principal In-Charge, I take pride in leading an institution that is committed to academic excellence, holistic student development, and community welfare.

The college offers undergraduate programmes in English, Assamese, Education, Economics, Political Science, and Sociology. In addition, it hosts a Study Centre of the Krishna Kanta Handiqui State Open University (KKHSOU), expanding opportunities for higher education in the region.

At Government Model College, Deithor, education extends beyond the classroom. Through seminars, educational tours, debates, youth parliament programmes, sports, cultural activities, and community outreach initiatives, we strive to build confident, responsible, and socially conscious individuals. The active involvement of the National Service Scheme (NSS), Women's Development Cell, Students' Affairs Committee, and other institutional bodies reflects our commitment to both student welfare and community development.

Despite being a young institution, the college has successfully organized three National Seminars and has encouraged students to participate in various academic, cultural, and sports events. We are proud that many of our alumni are pursuing higher studies in reputed universities and preparing for competitive examinations such as APSC and UPSC.

As we move forward, we remain dedicated to creating a vibrant learning environment that empowers students with knowledge, skills, and values. I invite students, parents, alumni, and well-wishers to join us in our journey towards excellence and meaningful social contribution.

 

With best wishes,
